nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks dated 17 Nov. Nigeria parallel ranges combine four independent current-day early observations updated at 03:37, 04:15, 06:00 and 06:07 WAT and rechecked at 08:07 WAT. The published extrema preserve cross-source and location dispersion rather than force a single quote. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. These are early observations, not live opening or executable quotes. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1.

Ghana.note: Bank of Ghana interbank mid-rates, 17 Nov (latest dated table); buy/sell and mid rows read directly.

Kenya.note: CBK commercial-banks' average closing rates, 17 Nov (latest verified; carried forward because the CBK table could not be read this morning); not a standalone buy or sell quote.

South Africa.note: SARB weighted-average bank rates, 17 Nov; values independently rechecked against a current mirror of the SARB publication.

Egypt.note: CBE official buy/sell mid-rates, 17 Nov; buy/sell rows independently rechecked and midpoints recomputed.

markets_note: Latest official reference values with effective dates: Ghana Bank of Ghana interbank mid-rates (17 Nov); Kenya CBK commercial-banks' average closing rates (17 Nov; not a standalone buy or sell quote); South Africa SARB weighted-average bank rates (17 Nov); Egypt CBE official buy/sell mid-rates (17 Nov).
